error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: The gate_claims_machine plan has no deterministic rule binding each claim's declared period metadata to the period filters used for raw recomputation, allowing CLM-NET-CZ to pass the numeric machine check while stating a different period.
summary: Independent raw-data recomputation reproduced all five registered values, but CLM-NET-CZ declares a period ending 2025-02-28 while its value was calculated through 2025-03-30; the claim therefore misstates the population period.
